paragraphs.text: When a candidate dispatch fails, the system records the failure to prevent immediate re-selection. The logic captures the source reference and error details to add a skip entry.
The default backoff duration is seven days. The system filters unexpired skips by comparing the stored expiration timestamp against the current time.

paragraphs.text: Persistence is performed atomically by writing the data to a temporary file first and then replacing the original file to ensure data integrity.

summary: fleet/bankedfire_linux.py manages failed candidate dispatches by recording skips in bankedfire_linux_skips.json with a default seven-day backoff. The file is updated atomically to ensure consistent state during persistent operations.
